It is not evidence that "all pretraining uses WSD": the main phase uses cosine planning. See also

4c9d657dbef024fd96db096c.zh: **SmolLM3 的配比与长度分别变化。**官方说明使用 WSD，并在阶段间提高代码和数学数据占比；长上下文适配随后单独进行，训练长度由 4K 分两次到 32K、64K，同时调整 RoPE 参数。官方把长上下文和推理适配称为 mid-training，说明阶段名的用法依项目而定。

d220bb63db69999f4aed4ba9.zh: **预训练（Pretraining）**是在大量数据上学习可迁移表示与预测能力的训练阶段。本书以自回归文本语言模型为主：给定前面的 token，预测接下来一个 token 的概率。Token 可以是一个词、词的一部分、字符片段或字节，并不固定等于一个汉字。
d220bb63db69999f4aed4ba9.en: **Pretraining** is the stage of learning transferable representations and prediction abilities on large amounts of data. This book focuses on autoregressive text language models: given the previous token, predict the probability of the next token. A token can be a word, part of a word, character fragment, or byte, and is not fixed to a Chinese character.

926703709352e89bd045b897.zh: **数据混合（Data Mixture）**描述训练时从不同来源、语言和领域抽样的分布。原始字节数、文档数与 token 数不是同一单位。中文、英文、代码经过同一分词器后，每字节对应的 token 数可能不同；配比需要明确以什么为分母。
926703709352e89bd045b897.en: **Data Mixture** describes the distribution of samples from different sources, languages, and domains during training. The number of original bytes, documents, and tokens are not the same unit. After Chinese, English, and code pass through the same tokenizer, the number of tokens per byte may differ; The ratio needs to be clearly defined as the denominator.

6a15dee5f5503f2cf6036de8.zh: 先写数据清单，再讨论比例。来源清单至少包含获取方式、可使用范围、语言、领域、时间范围、清洗版本、保留文档数和 token 数。一个来源很大，也可能主要是模板、导航和重复转载。
6a15dee5f5503f2cf6036de8.en: Write a data list first, then discuss the proportions. The source list should at least include the acquisition method, usable scope, language, domain, time range, cleaned version, number of documents retained, and number of tokens. A large source may mainly include templates, navigation, and repeated reposting.

b67f11fc42b0ba821abe3fb4.zh: 从磁盘分片到预取队列，再到不同DP副本，任何一处都可能改变实际消费。例如领域数据分片加载失败后，总用通用数据补位，就算配置仍写50%，真正看到的token也已改变。日志至少分开记录“请求份额、拿到的窗口、进入已提交更新的有效token、故障丢弃量”。
b67f11fc42b0ba821abe3fb4.en: From disk sharding to prefetching queues, and then to different DP replicas, any of these can alter actual consumption. For example, if domain data sharding fails to load, general data is always used to fill in, so even if the configuration is still written at 50%, the tokens actually seen have changed. Logs should at least separately record "request shares, received windows, valid tokens that have been submitted for updates, and failure drop amounts."

b3527cf0a54f81bef4ac670d.zh: 恢复时只用rank号派生新的数据顺序，会在成员变化后重新分配来源。生产方案需以稳定的来源/分片/窗口ID与全局游标连接数据和Infra；本书已有配比实验只在固定布局下有放回采样，不承诺具备这种生产迁移能力。2.5把这一交接写成检查点字段。
b3527cf0a54f81bef4ac670d.en: During recovery, only the rank number is used to derive new data sequences, and sources will be redistributed after member changes. Production solutions require a stable source/shard/window ID to connect data and the global cursor to the Infra; This book already includes proportional experiments that only re-sample with fixed layouts, and does not guarantee such production migration capability. 2.5 Write this handoff as a checkpoint field.

4e06151fdbbc17ed343fd5aa.zh: 先确定需要保留哪些能力，再固定分词器、模型、总训练 token 和评测设置，对照两种配比。看总体指标，也看各领域的损失与任务表现。只增加某领域数据同时增加训练总量，无法单独证明收益来自配比。
4e06151fdbbc17ed343fd5aa.en: First, determine which capabilities need to be retained, then fix the segmentation, model, total training tokens, and evaluation settings, and compare the two ratios. Look at overall metrics, as well as losses and task performance in each domain. Adding data in one domain while increasing total training volume cannot prove the benefits alone come from the matching ratio.

76d8abfe61cf07152a38374d.zh: 教学语料全部由项目原创，故意缩小了数据来源的不确定性。生产项目应对每类来源独立抽样审阅，核对文字能否读通、结构是否保留、时间范围是否满足需求。抽样得到的质量结论只覆盖对应分层，不能直接推及所有语料。
76d8abfe61cf07152a38374d.en: All teaching corpora are original to the project, intentionally reducing uncertainty in data sources. Production projects should independently sample and review each type of source, verifying whether the text can be read clearly, whether the structure is preserved, and whether the time frame meets requirements. The quality conclusions obtained from sampling only cover the corresponding strata and cannot be directly extended to all corpora.

5b2472716a65efde76a2c2f0.zh: **清洗（Cleaning）**要把不可用或不合目标的数据移除或修正。常见步骤是解析正文、规范编码、识别语言、检查长度、处理模板与异常重复，再做质量筛选。规则应有版本，每步保留多少数据、误删了哪些样例，都要可检查。
5b2472716a65efde76a2c2f0.en: **Cleaning** Remove or correct unusable or non-target data. Common steps include parsing the main text, standardizing encoding, recognizing language, checking length, handling templates and abnormal duplications, and then performing quality filtering. Rules should have versions; each step should have a version of data retention and errors deleted by mistake, all of which should be checkable.

2c165e4d712b0e32c508f873.zh: 规范化需要克制。把所有空白压成一个空格，可能破坏 Python 缩进；去掉标点可能改变公式和句子关系；用某类写作风格作为“高质量”标准，也可能排除少数语言或领域。清洗规则必须和数据类型一起评估。
2c165e4d712b0e32c508f873.en: Standardization requires restraint. Squeezing all the blanks into a single space may break Python indentation; Removing punctuation can change formulas and sentence relationships; Using a certain writing style as a "high-quality" standard may also exclude a few languages or fields. Cleansing rules must be evaluated together with data types.

4e0008b67ff645a9a5edf6a7.zh: Section titled “精确去重与近似去重”
4e0008b67ff645a9a5edf6a7.en: Section titled "Precise Deduplication and Approximate Deduplication"

ef24796a9aec41dae1af9a9b.zh: **去重（Deduplication）**避免同一内容以不同副本大量出现。精确去重对规范化后的文本计算哈希，识别完全一致内容；近似去重可用片段指纹、MinHash 等方法寻找高度重叠文档。阈值过严可能误删合法相似文本，过松则会保留转载。
ef24796a9aec41dae1af9a9b.en: **Deduplication** Prevents the same content from appearing in large numbers as different copies. Precise deduplication calculates hashes on standardized text to identify exactly identical content; Approximate deduplication can be found using fragment fingerprinting, MinHash, and other methods to find highly overlapping documents. Thresholds that are too strict may accidentally delete legally similar text; too loose may retain reprints.

4469e92fa5205fb198e1e3f2.en: Section titled "Handling Information Leaks During Division"

0f1872146f62abe1137e2a67.zh: **数据泄漏（Data Leakage）**意味着评估数据的信息通过训练流程进入了模型或决策过程。对预训练而言，污染可能来自题干、答案、解析或同源文档。仅仅把文件名分成 train 和 validation，并不能保证内容独立。
0f1872146f62abe1137e2a67.en: **Data Leakage** means that information evaluating data enters the model or decision-making process through the training process. For pre-training, contamination may come from the question stem, answers, explanations, or co-source documentation. Simply dividing the filename into train and validation does not guarantee content independence.

b8ad8b00c3c7e34e631619d4.zh: 实践中可以先给文档建立重复组、来源组或时间组，再按组划分。跨集合做哈希和近重复检查，避免同一文档的两个版本分别出现在训练与验证中。公开基准还需要额外建立污染检查清单，不能只检查自有验证集。
b8ad8b00c3c7e34e631619d4.en: In practice, you can first create duplicate groups, source groups, or time groups for the document, then divide them by group. Perform hashing and near-duplicate checks across sets to avoid two versions of the same document appearing separately in training and validation. Public benchmarks also require the creation of additional pollution checklists, rather than just checking your own validation set.

e9c1a34cd0ab895b599992ab.zh: **分词器（Tokenizer）**将文本编码为 token ID，并按同一约定解码。模型的嵌入表第 100 行与输出第 100 个得分，都对应词表中 ID 100 的含义。如果换了 ID 到文本片段的映射，相当于把模型熟悉的字典打乱。
e9c1a34cd0ab895b599992ab.en: **Tokenizer** encodes text into token IDs and decodes them according to the same convention. The 100th row of the model's embedding table and the 100th output score both correspond to the meaning of ID 100 in the list. If the mapping from ID to text fragments is changed, it is equivalent to shuffling the dictionary familiar to the model.

7dce100af417cf799d7a7259.zh: 分词器不仅包含词表，还可能包含规范化、预切分、合并规则、特殊 token 和后处理。发布模型时需要一起保存这些文件与版本。对话模板是另一层输入格式，也应记录，但不等同于分词算法本身。
7dce100af417cf799d7a7259.en: Segmented users not only include a list of words, but may also include normalization, pre-segmentation, merge rules, special tokens, and post-processing. When publishing the model, these files and versions need to be saved together. Dialogue templates are another layer of input format, which should also be recorded, but are not the same as the segmentation algorithm itself.

90d8a82b2fe75bcfe6890e51.zh: 大规模数据通常先离线分词，再存成可顺序读取的分片。运行时做预取、分布式切片和批次构造。要记录分片、偏移、shuffle 状态与抽样种子，才能判断恢复后是否跳过或重复样本。
90d8a82b2fe75bcfe6890e51.en: Large-scale data is usually segmented offline first, then stored as sequentially readable shards. Runtime performs prefetching, distributed slicing, and batch construction. Sharding, offsets, shuffle states, and sampling seeds must be recorded to determine whether samples are skipped or duplicated after recovery.

3edf215eef566d1e1a3f2df7.zh: TinyPretrain 为了便于学习，把每个划分串联成字节流后随机取窗口，显式构造输入与右移标签。它允许 EOS 两侧注意力相连，且用有放回随机窗口采样；“累计训练 token”因此不等于“唯一语料 token”。
3edf215eef566d1e1a3f2df7.en: TinyPretrain simplifies learning by slicing each partition into a byte stream and randomly selecting windows, explicitly constructing input and right-shift labels. It allows attention on both sides of EOS to be connected and samples with a re-placed random window; "Cumulative training token" therefore does not equal "unique corpus token."

e5822eeb8b977b983a116f51.zh: 预取队列需要限长和背压，否则可能把显存问题换成CPU内存问题。更重要的是区分“已读取/预取”和“已完成更新”：预取到了第120个窗口，检查点只提交到第100个，恢复应按既定协议重放尚未提交的部分，而不是跳到120。固定全局逻辑窗口ID和提交游标，是数据工程与弹性恢复的接口；普通DataLoader参数本身不提供这一保证。
e5822eeb8b977b983a116f51.en: Prefetching queues need to be limited in length and backpressure; otherwise, the memory issue may be replaced with a CPU memory issue. More importantly, distinguish between "read/prefetch" and "update completed": prefetching reaches window 120, checkpoints are only committed to the 100th, and recovery should replay the uncommitted portion according to the established protocol, not jump to 120. Fixing the global logical window ID and commit cursor serves as the interface between data engineering and elastic recovery; The standard DataLoader parameter itself does not provide this guarantee.

fb92a42e51115d31812b9cbd.zh: **数据清单（Data Manifest）**是连接原始来源、处理过程和训练输入的索引。它应该说明原始快照、清洗规则、去重版本、划分方式、分词器哈希、分片列表及校验值。相同文件名不是相同数据，大小相同也不是。
fb92a42e51115d31812b9cbd.en: **Data Manifest** is an index connecting the original source, processing steps, and training inputs. It should describe the original snapshot, cleaning rules, deduplication versions, partitioning methods, segmented hashes, sharded lists, and checksums. The same filename is not the same data, and the same size is not the same.

6ae5469fdcef3c2445d8e317.zh: 把 manifest 作为训练配置的一部分保存。若改变了分词器，旧 token 文件通常不再有效；若改变了验证划分，前后 loss 不能直接当成同一指标曲线。
6ae5469fdcef3c2445d8e317.en: Save the manifest as part of the training configuration. If the segmentation is changed, the old token file is usually no longer valid; If the validation partition is changed, the previous and subsequent losses cannot be treated as the same metric curve.

e72d91bfac369bd285e944a9.en: During training, the entire real text is given, and each position can calculate its next token score in the same forward run, with causal masks ensuring the future is not visible. 8aeb5b38d0b8de8f05f50028.en: : Attention determines which historical locations to retrieve information from, the feedforward network processes these representations, and stacked blocks gradually form features for prediction of the next token.

d9187609ad2e8ab4d37f15d4.en: TinyPretrain uses PyTorch's TransformerEncoderLayer plus causal masks to implement homogeneous self-attention stacking. The Encoder in the class name cannot independently determine whether the model is bidirectional; the actual visible range depends on the mask; The teaching implementation is not equivalent to fully reproducing a production model.

a6f3ff447d7aa1ab5110a019.zh: 生产模型可能使用 GQA 减少 K/V 头、SwiGLU 改变前馈计算、MoE 只激活部分专家。比较这些架构需要同时报告总参数、激活参数、训练计算和路由/通信开销。本书预算默认稠密模型，不把它的公式直接套给 MoE。
a6f3ff447d7aa1ab5110a019.en: Production models may use GQA to reduce K/V heads, SwiGLU changes feedforward computation, and MoE only activates some experts. Comparing these architectures requires reporting total parameters, activation parameters, training computations, and routing/communication overhead simultaneously. The book's budget defaults to dense models and does not apply its formulas directly to MoE.

6817d44cc497a3589c7fdd5c.zh: 注意力按内容比较位置，如果没有额外顺序信息，无法仅靠这一操作理解 token 的先后。**位置编码（Positional Encoding）**让位置信息进入网络。可学习绝对位置嵌入把位置映射到向量并与 token 表示相加；**旋转位置编码（RoPE）**则对 Query/Key 的部分维度施加与位置相关的旋转。
6817d44cc497a3589c7fdd5c.en: Attention compares positions by content; without additional sequential information, it is impossible to understand the order of tokens by this operation alone. **Positional Encoding** Allows position information to enter the network. Absolute position embedding can be learned, mapping positions to vectors and adding them to token representations; **Rotational Position Encoding (RoPE)** applies position-related rotations to certain dimensions of Query/Key.

07ba0f1eeddfc05e7c9ad90d.zh: 不同方案具有不同外推行为。可学习表超过已分配位置会越界；RoPE 数学上能计算更大位置，但模型是否在更长距离上可靠工作，还取决于训练分布和扩展方法。
07ba0f1eeddfc05e7c9ad90d.en: Different schemes have different external derivatives. Learnable tables that exceed assigned positions will exceed boundaries; RoPE can mathematically compute larger positions, but whether the model works reliably over longer distances depends on training distributions and scaling methods.

b084cc1a91045eac862c0214.zh: 单次内容注意力若没有任何顺序线索，不能仅由内容匹配恢复先后关系；完整因果网络的掩码本身也打破对称性。因此 NoPE 不等于“整个系统没有顺序信息”。显式位置方案仍要结合掩码和训练分布分析，不能从某个部件是否存在直接推断长文本能力。

Explicit positional schemes still need to combine masks and training distribution analysis, and cannot directly infer long text capability from whether a component exists.

99d4a8ccf6020f2d66d978a0.zh: 按长度区间报告验证损失，再加入明确需要远程信息的任务。检查答案所在位置、干扰内容、提示格式和截断方式。只测“把一句话藏在长文本里能否找出”，不足以覆盖跨段推理、结构理解和稳健引用。
99d4a8ccf6020f2d66d978a0.en: Report and verify losses by length interval, then add tasks that clearly require telecommunications. Check the location of the answer, the content of the interference, the prompt format, and the truncation method. Testing only "whether a sentence hidden in a long text can be found" is insufficient to cover cross-paragraph reasoning, structural understanding, and robust citation.

36f9a89e30a43a15dc647f80.zh: **规模定律（Scaling Law）**用经验函数描述损失与模型规模、数据量和计算预算之间的关系。它来自一组受控实验的拟合，适用性与数据、模型家族、训练方法和规模范围相关，不是脱离条件的自然常数。
36f9a89e30a43a15dc647f80.en: **Scaling Law** uses empirical functions to describe the relationship between loss and model size, data volume, and computational budget. It comes from fitting a set of controlled experiments, where applicability depends on data, model families, training methods, and scale range, not natural constants out of condition.

fb67317a322717e30c558a0a.zh: Chinchilla 研究表明，在其研究设置下，固定训练计算预算时，模型规模与训练 token 都需要增长。常被引用的“约 20 token/参数”适合作为某类训练预算的粗略起点，不能当成全部模型的数据上限或最优训练长度。[1]
fb67317a322717e30c558a0a.en: Chinchilla's research shows that under his research setup, when the training computation budget is fixed, both model size and training tokens need to grow. The commonly cited "about 20 tokens/parameter" is suitable as a rough starting point for a certain type of training budget and cannot be regarded as the data ceiling or optimal training length for the entire model. [1]

b939bcd9ae77db4c8f74009d.zh: **混合精度（Mixed Precision）**让不同计算和状态使用不同精度，以平衡速度、内存与稳定性。FP32、FP16 与 BF16 的指数范围和有效精度不同；BF16 的指数范围接近 FP32，但尾数更短。它并不自动让训练免于 NaN。
b939bcd9ae77db4c8f74009d.en: **Mixed Precision** Allows different calculations and states to use different precision levels to balance speed, memory, and stability. FP32, FP16, and BF16 have different exponential ranges and effective precision; BF16's exponential range is close to FP32, but with a shorter latina. It does not automatically free training from NaN.

8137e0dedd420ce379509104.zh: 按操作选择计算类型，并不意味着所有参数和优化器状态都变为低精度。应区分权重存储类型、内核运算类型、累积类型与优化器状态类型。
8137e0dedd420ce379509104.en: Choosing the calculation type by operation does not mean that all parameters and optimizer states become low-precision. Weight storage types, kernel operation types, cumulative types, and optimizer state types should be distinguished.

4902b12454d924e9ec947328.zh: **梯度范数裁剪（Gradient Norm Clipping）**在范数超过阈值时整体缩放梯度。使用 loss scaling 时，需要先 unscale，再裁剪，再执行优化器步骤。累积尚未完成或梯度尚未正确同步时就裁剪，会改变实际更新。
4902b12454d924e9ec947328.en: **Gradient Norm Clipping** Scales the gradient globally when the norm exceeds a threshold. When using loss scaling, you need to unscale first, then clip, and finally execute the optimizer step. Clipping before accumulation is complete or gradients are not properly synchronized will change the actual update.

a7a12c1bf842a35bbc8797d6.zh: 梯度范数也应进入日志。持续触发裁剪可能提示学习率、数据、初始化或归一化需要检查；不能因为“裁剪后暂时不炸”就认为问题已经解决。
a7a12c1bf842a35bbc8797d6.en: The gradient norm should also be included in the log. Continuously triggering clipping may indicate that learning rate, data, initialization, or normalization need to be checked; You should not assume the problem is solved just because "it doesn't explode after trimming."

72ad1df4193512c2173a331b.zh: 普通 DDP 归约后每 rank 有完整梯度，范数可在本地完整参数上计算。FSDP / ZeRO 等方案可能只保留梯度分片，单 rank 的局部范数不等于全模型范数；TP 还要区分分片和重复参数，避免重复计数。应使用所用版本提供的分布式范数 / 裁剪机制，并核对参与组，不把本书
72ad1df4193512c2173a331b.en: Ordinary DDP reduces with a full gradient per rank, and the norm can be calculated on the local full parameters. Schemes like FSDP / ZeRO may only retain gradient sharding, and the local norm for a single rank is not equal to the full model norm; TP should also distinguish between sharding and duplicate parameters to avoid duplicate counting. 278dbc0c83e647fb8468efb9.zh: 出现 NaN 时记录最早异常的 loss、梯度和批次，而不是等它传播到权重之后。核对学习率、恢复后的状态、标签范围、掩码是否让某行没有可见位置，以及数据中是否出现异常样本。必要时短暂用 FP32 重跑同一小批次，比较异常是否依旧。
278dbc0c83e647fb8468efb9.en: When NaN occurs, record the earliest anomaly loss, gradient, and batch, rather than waiting for it to propagate to the weight. Check learning rate, restored state, label range, whether masks make a row invisible, and whether abnormal samples appear in the data. If necessary, briefly rerun the same small batch with FP32 to compare whether the anomaly persists.

cd6f21c12c83bac558b665e6.zh: 如果多卡中只有一个 rank 先出错，要保存各 rank 的输入身份；集合通信可能把异常传播给其他副本。单机“能跑”不等于分布式状态一定正确。
cd6f21c12c83bac558b665e6.en: If only one rank in a multi-card system fails first, the input identity of each rank must be saved; Collective communication may propagate exceptions to other replicas. A single machine "can run" does not necessarily mean the distributed state is correct.

bb1dddbce816a5a4e09ad21c.zh: TinyPretrain 默认采用 FP32，优先让 CPU 实验容易复现。它检查 loss 和梯度范数是否有限，失败时停止写入新的有效检查点；它没有实现完整 BF16/FP16 路径，生产精度切换需要按框架文档单独验证。
bb1dddbce816a5a4e09ad21c.en: TinyPretrain uses FP32 by default, prioritizing easy reproduction of CPU experiments. It checks whether loss and gradient norms are limited, and stops writing new valid checkpoints if it fails; It does not implement a complete BF16/FP16 path, so production accuracy switching must be verified separately according to the framework documentation.

03bbe42021bcab72b8c16ff2.zh: 先完成同一 scale 的累积及 DDP 归约，再一次 unscale、检查并裁剪；scaler 可能跳过更新。按成功更新的 step/调度器仅在真正更新时前进，不能靠 step 返回 None 判断成功。分片梯度需对应的分布式范数实现。
03bbe42021bcab72b8c16ff2.en: First, accumulate and reduce DDP for the same scale, then unscale, check, and crop again; scalers may skip updates. A step/scheduler updated by a successful update only advances during the actual update and cannot be checked as success by returning to None by step. Sharding gradients require corresponding distributed norms to be implemented.

9df17c6274f4bfbc5e91c227.zh: 每个 rank 要得到独立且可追踪的数据流。如果所有 rank 使用相同随机种子并从同一位置抽样，可能反复读到相同批次，增加了机器却没增加有效样本覆盖。使用 DistributedSampler 时要核对 epoch 更新、补齐和丢尾语义。
9df17c6274f4bfbc5e91c227.en: Each rank should have an independent and traceable data stream. If all ranks use the same random seed and sample from the same location, they may repeatedly read the same batch, increasing machine coverage without increasing effective sample coverage. When using DistributedSampler, check epoch updates, padding and tail semantics.

a5d949bf026b66658c08e16d.zh: 全局批量通常与数据并行副本数成正比。由单卡扩到多卡，如果保持每卡批量和累积不变，全局批量也变了。它既改变吞吐，也改变优化行为，不能只把训练步数照抄。
a5d949bf026b66658c08e16d.en: Global batch size is usually proportional to the number of parallel copies of the data. Expanding from single cards to multiple cards, if the batch and cumulative amount per card remain unchanged, the global batch also changes. It changes both throughput and optimization behavior; it cannot simply copy the number of training steps.

5b388905d018d8b0579fd07b.zh: 检测到多个进程时创建 DDP，每个 rank 用独立训练采样生成器，验证后归约结果。检查点由 rank 0 写入，保存所有 rank 的随机状态；恢复要求相同 world size。默认 CPU 使用 Gloo，CUDA 使用 NCCL。多机、多网卡和状态分片仍需专门配置与验收。
5b388905d018d8b0579fd07b.en: When multiple processes are detected, a DDP is created, with each rank using an independent training sampling generator, verifying and reducing the result. Checkpoints are written by rank 0 to store the random state of all ranks; Recovery requires the same world size. The default CPU uses Gloo, CUDA uses NCCL. Multi-machine, multi-network card, and state sharding still require dedicated configuration and acceptance.

8c85ad73269b6638bc161228.zh: DDP 通常保留完整参数、梯度和优化器状态；分片方案减少特定冗余，但增加聚合/通信行为。应明确实际策略和峰值，而非只写框架名。
8c85ad73269b6638bc161228.en: DDP typically retains full parameters, gradients, and optimizer states; Sharding solutions reduce specific redundancy but increase aggregation/communication behavior. Actual policies and peaks should be clearly defined rather than just the framework name.

a803c38c37606eb5b912e33d.zh: **检查点（Checkpoint）**是某个训练时刻的状态快照。用于推理的权重可以不包含优化器；用于延续同一次训练的快照，则需要更多状态。恢复目标也分层：能加载继续运行、统计上延续、同环境下严格一致，要求逐级提高。
a803c38c37606eb5b912e33d.en: **Checkpoints** are snapshots of the state at a specific training moment. Weights used for inference can exclude optimizers; Snapshots used to continue the same training require more states. Recovery goals are also layered: load and continue running, statistically continue, strictly consistent with the environment, and must be increased step by step.

0aff543d8f6f117b4cfc7381.zh: 单机可先写临时文件，完成后在同一文件系统原子替换目标路径。分布式分片检查点则需要确认所有必要分片成功，再提交完成标记与清单。最终还应做完整性与实际加载检查；单机改名不自动提供跨机器事务。
0aff543d8f6f117b4cfc7381.en: A single machine can first write a temporary file, then atomically replace the target path within the same file system. Distributed sharding checkpoints require confirming that all necessary shards are successful before submitting completion marks and checklists. Finally, completeness and actual loading checks should be performed; Single-machine renaming does not automatically provide cross-machine transactions.

66e9d944a066f252b9aa6f5f.zh: 检查点频率需要平衡写入成本与潜在丢失计算。若每次保存耗时较长，过于频繁会明显降低吞吐；间隔太久则增加故障回滚量。依据观察到的故障和保存时间制定策略，并保留多个已验证版本。
66e9d944a066f252b9aa6f5f.en: Checkpoint frequency needs to balance write costs with potential loss calculations. If each save takes a long time, too frequent will significantly reduce throughput; Too long intervals increase failure rollback. Develop strategies based on observed failures and save times, and retain multiple verified versions.

cb0d0c16f852d015c43bdbd3.zh: ：恢复不是“把权重读回来”，而是让参数、更新历史、数据位置与随机过程重新对上同一时刻。
cb0d0c16f852d015c43bdbd3.en: : Recovery is not about "reading weights back," but about aligning parameters, update history, data positions, and random processes at the same moment again.

093d891090aa343a48df825c.zh: Section titled “真正演练一次恢复”

54f76418604044af1cc6c052.zh: 先做固定总计划的连续运行，再做在中间停止、从检查点继续的运行。相同环境下比较最后参数、优化器状态、步数和 token。若硬件、内核或并行度发生变化，严格逐位一致可能不成立，需定义允许的数值误差或统计标准。
54f76418604044af1cc6c052.en: First, run a fixed master plan continuously, then stop in the middle and continue running from the checkpoint. Compare the final parameters, optimizer status, number of steps, and tokens under the same environment. If hardware, kernel, or parallelism changes, strict bitwise consistency may not hold; it is necessary to define allowable numerical errors or statistical standards.

31add5988a3a48904646403e.en: The teaching experiment provides a recovery verification script: fixed CPU, threads, data, and seeds, comparing the final state of continuous training and segmented recovery. It checks configuration and data hash together; Requires the same world size during recovery and saves the random generator state for each rank. Multi-card consistency requires retesting in the actual target environment.

29ed275a20aacce9d0cde99c.zh: **能力评测（Capability Evaluation）**用任务衡量模型在指定设置中的表现。知识选择题、阅读理解、代码生成和数学解答分别测量不同侧面；一个平均分无法解释所有能力。基础模型还可能不熟悉聊天式指令，评估格式应与模型类型相匹配。
29ed275a20aacce9d0cde99c.en: **Capability Evaluation** Measures the model's performance within specified settings using tasks. Knowledge multiple-choice questions, reading comprehension, code generation, and math solutions measure different aspects separately; A single average score cannot explain all abilities. The base model may also be unfamiliar with chat-style commands, so the evaluation format should match the model type.

f596712b976f0918eee5e8e4.zh: 权重、提示和生成输出均未改变，变化来自评分接口。抽取器必须在比较前固定，同样作用于全部模型，保留原文、抽取结果与解析失败数；不能看见答案后逐题定制。
f596712b976f0918eee5e8e4.en: Weights, prompts, and generated outputs remain unchanged; changes come from the scoring interface. The extractor must be fixed before comparison and applies to all models, retaining the original text, extraction results, and parsing failure counts; You cannot customize each question after seeing the answer.

55def3936d976faad5af44e9.zh: 提示也属于测量条件。例如“只输出选项字母”与“解释后给出选项”可能改变格式和生成长度，但本书没有运行这两种提示，不填分数。若比较提示，固定题集与检查点、保存逐题输出，再区分真实答案变化与抽取失败。
55def3936d976faad5af44e9.en: Prompts are also considered measurement conditions. For example, "output option letters only" and "provide options after explanation" may change format and generation length, but this book does not run these prompts and does not fill in scores. For comparison prompts, fix the question set and checkpoints, save each question output, and distinguish between real answer changes and extraction failures.

9b3a4593335fe47318e1bfe9.zh: Section titled “一份最小评测记录”

893aeac41ccef4f5c689c66c.zh: 保存模型与检查点哈希、分词器、任务数据版本、评测工具版本、提示模板、few-shot 数、随机种子、上下文截断、解码参数、精度和答案抽取规则。若模型是自定义架构，还要确认评测后端能正确加载。
893aeac41ccef4f5c689c66c.en: Save the model and checkpoint hash, word segmentation, task data version, evaluation tool version, prompt template, few-shot count, random seed, context truncation, decoding parameters, accuracy, and answer extraction rules. If the model is a custom architecture, also ensure the evaluation backend loads correctly.

da3c3f0541081ef2fc6d6770.zh: EleutherAI 的 lm-evaluation-harness 提供多种任务与后端。CLI 会随版本变化，实际命令要固定到所用版本；先用小任务验证加载与评分，再全量运行。TinyPretrain 的自定义字节模型没有直接伪装成 Hugging Face 格式，本站也不提供未经验证的“通用一行评测命令”。
da3c3f0541081ef2fc6d6770.en: EleutherAI's lm-evaluation-harness provides various tasks and backends. The CLI changes with version, and actual commands must be fixed to the version used; First, use small tasks to verify loading and score, then run them full. TinyPretrain's custom byte model is not directly disguised as Hugging Face format, and our site does not provide unverified "generic one-line evaluation commands."

93b302a4dd9a1a472fb98717.zh: ：评测分数属于“某个模型在某套题、某种提示和评分规则下”的结果，不能脱离这些条件解释。
93b302a4dd9a1a472fb98717.en: : The evaluation score is the result of "a certain model under a certain set of questions, a certain prompt, and scoring rule," and cannot be explained separately from these conditions.

a4dd8b56a8b12715311beba7.zh: Section titled “比较需要误差与样本”
a4dd8b56a8b12715311beba7.en: Section titled "Comparison Requires Error and Samples"

76903b36e9a84112b87b2138.zh: 记录评测样本数、失败数量和无效输出率。对两个模型在同一批题上的差异，可以查看逐题配对结果，并按合适方法估计不确定性。少量样本中的一两题差异，可能不足以支撑广泛能力提升的判断。
76903b36e9a84112b87b2138.en: Record the number of evaluation samples, number of failures, and invalid output rate. For differences between two models on the same issue, you can check the pairing results for each question and estimate uncertainty using appropriate methods. Differences in one or two questions in a small sample may not be sufficient to support broad skill improvement assessments.

d44d28ad1fb6fcc9eb02de6b.zh: 如果重复用同一基准选择模型和配比，它逐渐成为开发集。最终结论需要保留独立评测或明确报告选择过程。不要将反复挑选后的最好分数当作一次无偏测试。
d44d28ad1fb6fcc9eb02de6b.en: If the same benchmark is used repeatedly to select models and ratios, it gradually becomes a development set. The final conclusion should retain independent evaluation or clearly report the selection process. Do not treat the best score after repeated selection as an unbiased test.

0c78d328b40b87f77c72f628.zh: Section titled “从汇总分回到失败案例”
0c78d328b40b87f77c72f628.en: Section titled "From Summary Scores to Failure Cases"

437fb743186bb84a109289e0.zh: 对失败样本区分知识缺失、格式错误、截断、答案抽取问题和真实推理失败。修复解析器时需重跑所有对比模型，避免只给一个模型更有利的评分。报告中保留基线、相同设置和已知污染范围，才能让下游判断结果适用性。
437fb743186bb84a109289e0.en: Distinguish between knowledge gaps, formatting errors, truncation, answer extraction problems, and true reasoning failures for failed samples. When repairing parsers, rerun all comparison models to avoid giving only one model a more favorable score. Keep baselines, identical settings, and known contamination ranges in the report to ensure downstream judgment of the applicability of results.

027f8ff6eddd87338b246a93.zh: 保存原始输出并用同一预定义规则重评所有模型，报告解析失败。不能只给某个模型换有利规则或按标准答案逐题修补。
027f8ff6eddd87338b246a93.en: Save the original output and re-evaluate all models using the same predefined rule, reporting parsing failure. You cannot simply change favorable rules to a single model or patch each question according to the standard answer.

e18ea71ad76c5f64ebb81570.zh: 没有，原始输出和权重都未变，只把“答案：4。”规范为“4”。评分接口变化会改变数值，因此条件必须随分数发布。
e18ea71ad76c5f64ebb81570.en: No, the original output and weight remain unchanged, only "Answer: 4." "Standard is set to "4". Changes in the scoring interface will alter the value, so the condition must be published with the score.

9df6038c80b314325cf74b53.zh: 检查点、数据/工具版本、提示、抽取、样本量与波动、污染和选择过程。平均分不能代表所有任务都提高。
9df6038c80b314325cf74b53.en: Checkpoints, data/tool versions, prompts, sampling, sample size and fluctuations, contamination, and selection process. An average score does not mean improvement for all tasks.

36cf93550af6661490eb42a7.zh: 。多场景与多指标的系统评估。
36cf93550af6661490eb42a7.en: 。 Systematic evaluation of multiple scenarios and multiple indicators.

282220592ef0819c7115a7ad.en: What are the risks of publishing only the highest score among all trials?

a64e3dca04321082f28518a5.zh: Section titled “污染有不同的粒度”
a64e3dca04321082f28518a5.en: Section titled "Pollution Has Different Granular Levels"

57c1fb407361f35a2634198c.zh: **评测污染（Benchmark Contamination）**可能来自题目、答案、解析、翻译版或高度相似变体。只做整条哈希检查通常只能覆盖精确副本。片段匹配与近重复检测扩大覆盖，但也有误报和漏报，需要抽样核查。
57c1fb407361f35a2634198c.en: **Benchmark Contamination** may come from questions, answers, explanations, translations, or highly similar variants. Performing only a full hash check usually only covers an exact copy. Fragment matching and near-repeat detection expand coverage, but false positives and missed positives also occur, requiring sampling verification.

3002aa6d86f6d7d2fe951117.zh: 检测到重叠并不自动证明该题表现完全来自记忆；没有检测到重叠也不证明训练从未见过语义等价内容。报告要把检测证据和对模型行为的推断分开。
3002aa6d86f6d7d2fe951117.en: Detecting overlap does not automatically prove that the problem is entirely from memory; Nor does it prove that the training never saw semantic equivalents. The report should separate the evidence tested from inferences about model behavior.

f67d3c1ba9e93d19a31945a0.zh: Section titled “基线要获得同样的待遇”
f67d3c1ba9e93d19a31945a0.en: Section titled "Baseline Must Be Treated the Same"

aa08123e77075f06525d53f0.en: Otherwise, what impact might be mixed in?

1cbcf354b7de9d9a8448d02d.en: More calculations or different task calibers

2aa8b80bd598898d12c35e79.en: Parameter / Calculation Basis and Parameter Adjustment Budget

b12d7307ea96d9520dab9156.zh: 更大容量或更多调参机会
b12d7307ea96d9520dab9156.en: Greater capacity or more opportunities for parameter tuning

81dfae3454bbbd22cf341814.zh: 输入、权重、允许数值误差
81dfae3454bbbd22cf341814.en: Input, weights, and allowable numerical errors

1f81bae372ec9dc6da3a1725.zh: token、时间或计算预算的目标
1f81bae372ec9dc6da3a1725.en: Tokens, time, or calculating budget goals

1f7b1276f5922c3fa1840384.zh: “公平”不等于每个数都相同，而是先明确比较的问题。例如固定训练 FLOPs 与固定模型参数，回答的是不同问题。
1f7b1276f5922c3fa1840384.en: "Fairness" does not mean that every number is the same, but rather that the question of comparison is clearly defined. For example, fixed-training FLOPs and fixed-model parameters answer different questions.

57c84876c75b3686bd5ddb12.zh: ：可信比较要说清哪些条件固定、哪些条件改变，以及还有什么其他因素能解释分数差异。
57c84876c75b3686bd5ddb12.en: : Reliable comparison requires clarifying which conditions are fixed, which have changed, and what other factors can explain the score differences.

c663d8a58c3fae1b1b388d57.zh: Section titled “反复挑最好的一次会怎样”
c663d8a58c3fae1b1b388d57.en: Section titled "What Happens If You Repeatedly Choose the Best Opportunity?"

12765c4b734896f483c4f934.zh: 多次尝试不同提示、种子和检查点，再只展示最高分，会产生选择偏差。应公开选择规则、尝试范围和最终独立测量。若只完成一次小规模实验，结论就应限于该设置；不要把试探性观察写成稳定规律。
12765c4b734896f483c4f934.en: Repeatedly trying different prompts, seeds, and checkpoints and then showing only the highest score will result in selection bias. Selection rules, trial ranges, and final independent measurements should be made public. If only one small-scale experiment is completed, conclusions should be limited to this setup; Do not write tentative-based observations as stable patterns.

2b9b2fe0f2869da1bab1550c.zh: 对污染检查，可以分别报告原始集合、去除检出重叠后的集合，以及检出数量。去除后的集合也可能改变题目难度，因此两个集合的分数不能简单相减当作“记忆贡献”。
2b9b2fe0f2869da1bab1550c.en: For contamination checks, you can separately report the original set, remove the detected overlap, and the detected quantity. The removed set may also change the difficulty of the problem, so the fractions of two sets cannot be simply subtracted as a "memory contribution."

0b210ac7d5abdce91fc7610b.zh: Section titled “教学实验怎样保持诚实”
0b210ac7d5abdce91fc7610b.en: Section titled "How to Maintain Honesty in Teaching Experiments"

ff7bc7cc1b8ec48ecfb34ecd.zh: 本项目只展示训练机制，不报告未经运行的大模型基准成绩。恢复验证测试的是同条件状态一致性，不能替代泛化验证。原创短文本中有共享主题和模板，所以即便 train/val 文档不相同，也不能用它声称完全排除了语义重叠。
ff7bc7cc1b8ec48ecfb34ecd.en: This project only demonstrates the training mechanism and does not report the benchmark scores for large models that have not been run. Restored verification tests focus on consistency under the same conditional state and cannot replace generalization validation. Original short texts share themes and templates, so even if the train/val documents are different, they cannot be used to claim complete elimination of semantic overlap.

00a67b9afba01d9716742afd.zh: 当你迁移到真实数据时，把污染策略、基线和选择过程写入实验计划，再开始训练；训练结束后补写规则，容易无意中追着结果调整口径。

28e8cc98a8e0470a6486b7f1.zh: **消融实验（Ablation）**有控制地移除或改变一项因素，观察目标指标。一次同时改数据、学习率和精度，无法知道是哪一项起作用。它可以作为紧急止损，但不应该被当成根因证明。
28e8cc98a8e0470a6486b7f1.en: **Ablation Experiments** Controlledly remove or change a factor to observe the target metric. Modify data, learning rate, and accuracy simultaneously, but it is impossible to know which one is working. It can serve as an emergency stop-loss but should not be used as root cause proof.

3ff41b9aa644d40ed76d1f5c.zh: 为每个实验写下假设、唯一主要改动、固定条件、预算和判断标准。比如“尖峰来自样本解析错误”：保留相同权重和优化器，用原样本与修复样本比较首个异常位置、loss 和梯度。确认后再进行更长验证。
3ff41b9aa644d40ed76d1f5c.en: Write hypotheses, the only major change, fixed conditions, budget, and criteria for each experiment. For example, "spikes come from sample resolution errors": keep the same weights and optimizers, and compare the initial anomaly location, loss, and gradient with the original sample and the repair sample. After confirmation, conduct longer validation.

214e2d32c1b4c3604ff7d270.zh: ：诊断从保存证据开始，消融让某个解释承担被实验推翻的风险。

0850695f2212eb501ce85f44.zh: 极短序列检查可以发现右移错误；固定小批次过拟合可以测试模型是否具备基本学习能力；从相同检查点继续两步可以定位恢复或随机状态；单卡与多卡的小规模对照可以检查同步语义。它们各自只验证局部条件。
0850695f2212eb501ce85f44.en: Ultra-short sequence checks can detect right shift errors; Fixed small-batch overfitting tests whether the model has basic learning ability; Continuing two steps from the same checkpoint can locate recovery or random states; Small-scale single-card versus multi-card comparisons can check synchronous semantics. Each verifies only local conditions.

7f9027926954f3fbc3847fca.zh: 能过拟合小批次，不代表真实数据质量好；单卡正常，也不证明多机通信没问题。测试结论要限于它实际覆盖的范围。
7f9027926954f3fbc3847fca.en: Passing a fit for a small batch does not necessarily mean the real data quality is good; A single SIM working normally does not prove that multi-device communication is fine. Test conclusions should be limited to the actual coverage area.

451fc40bba308df14bc52bbf.zh: 每条记录包含运行 ID、检查点、数据指纹、环境、现象、假设、改动与结果。即使假设被否定，也保留结论，避免团队重复尝试。公开报告区分已确认原因、支持但未确认的推测和仍未解决的异常。
451fc40bba308df14bc52bbf.en: Each record contains the run ID, checkpoints, data fingerprints, environment, phenomena, assumptions, changes, and results. Even if a hypothesis is dismissed, the conclusion is preserved to avoid repeated attempts by the team. Public reports distinguish between confirmed causes, supported but unconfirmed speculation, and unresolved anomalies.

5f84fda56005d046c6c9a055.zh: **持续预训练（Continued Pretraining，CPT）**从已有权重出发，通常沿用语言建模目标，在补充语料上继续学习。它与“从同一次运行的检查点恢复”不同：数据分布、学习率、训练预算甚至上下文方案都可能发生变化，应建立新的运行身份。
5f84fda56005d046c6c9a055.en: **Continued Pretraining (CPT)** Starting from existing weights, it usually continues to use language modeling objectives and continue learning on supplementary corpora. It differs from "recovering from checkpoints on the same run": data distribution, learning rate, training budget, and even context schemes may all change, so a new operational identity should be established.

f7c6f6e75ca611b9ab1411c5.zh: 已有模型带来能力与偏好，也带来分词器和架构约束。未经设计直接换分词器，容易使嵌入含义错配；增大上下文还需要位置方案和长文本评估配套。
f7c6f6e75ca611b9ab1411c5.en: Existing models bring capabilities and preferences, but also paragraphers and architectural constraints. Changing the subpar without design can easily cause embedding meaning mismatch; Increasing context also requires positional schemes and long-text evaluation support.

ae5975469e596774601e1285.zh: **灾难性遗忘（Catastrophic Forgetting）**指适应新数据时旧能力明显退化。混入通用数据、控制训练量和调节更新方式可能缓解，但具体效果要实验确认，不能保证某个固定比例足够。
ae5975469e596774601e1285.en: **Catastrophic Forgetting** refers to a significant decline in the ability to adapt to new data and old data. Mixing in general data, controlling training volume, and adjusting update methods may alleviate the situation, but the specific effects must be experimentally confirmed and cannot guarantee that a fixed proportion is sufficient.

3d8ef8976986f08dc5fbe8f4.zh: **模型卡（Model Card）**说明模型的预期用途、训练概况、评测条件和局限。对预训练模型要区分它是基础模型还是经过后训练的助手，避免把文本续写当作可靠事实服务。数据说明应给出可以披露的范围和处理方法，不编造无法验证的完整来源。
3d8ef8976986f08dc5fbe8f4.en: **Model Card** Explain the model's intended use, training overview, evaluation criteria, and limitations. For pre-trained models, distinguish whether it is a base model or a post-trained assistant, and avoid treating text continuation as a reliable factual service. Data descriptions should provide disclosed scope and handling methods, without fabricating unverifiable complete sources.

Strict bitwise reproduction requires identical hardware, software, and deterministic conditions; Cross-device reproduction usually requires defined values or statistical criteria.
